posts.t: Sorokin starts tonight for #Isles, per DeBoer.
DeBoer said Barzal (left knee), Maccelli (lower body) and Ritchie (lower body) will not travel. #Isles

Brayden Schenn's kids are watching #Isles practice. Schaefer came over to the glass and gave them a fist bump.

They start a "Let's Go Schaefer" chant.

#Isles lines at Saturday's practice before ✈️  @bullsmithsli: 

Holmstrom-Horvat-Palmieri
Heineman-Schenn-Eklund
Palat-Pageau-Duclair
MacLean-Cizikas-Chaffee

Stanley-Schaefer
Pelech-Pulock
Kessel-DeAngelo
E: Mayfield

Sorokin 
Varlamov

New PDOcast with Thomas Hickey:

•Having front row seat for the Senators vs. Panthers game
•Things you notice while watching NHL games from between the benches
•Pete DeBoer's impact on the Islanders 5v5 numbers
•Matthew Schaefer in Year 2

www.patreon.com/TheHockeyPDO...
Heineman-Horvat-Schaefer after Pageau won the opening draw. #Isles
Varlamov with two big-time saves. Got to give him credit. He's rebounded. Pun intended. #Isles

With that goal, Schaefer ties Orr for the second-most goals in #NHL history by a teenage defenseman with 24. 

Housley leads with 46.
With that goal, Schaefer has nine points (1G, 8A) in 10 games this season. #Isles

Matthew. Schaefer. Tie game with 12:54 to go in the third. He just walked in and picked his spot, beating Kuemper blocker side. 

That's his first goal of the season and it's a biggy. 

2-2.

#Isles
Varlamov with an aggressive glove save early in the third. #Isles
Back for the third. #Isles down 2-1 but they've been on the attack for most of this game. See if they can bail out Varlamov and take this game in regulation.

#Isles down 2-1 after 2. Outshooting #GoKingsGo 32-14. 

If NYI keeps doing what they're doing, I like their chances. 

Eklund with the lone goal of the frame on the PP.
Schaefer goes off for hooking. Wright for holding. 2:15 to go in the second. 4-on-4. 2-1 LAK.
Schaefer just toe-dragged and then megged Zuccarello. #Isles

Victor. Eklund. PP one-timer sneaks through Kuemper and it's a 2-1 game with 5:54 to go in the second.

Took a sec for that puck to cross the goal line, but it did.
Schenn has been one of the most dangerous #Isles tonight.
Holmstrom dekes through a few players but Kuemper sprawls out to make his 27th save of the night. #Isles
Pelech wrist shot deflected by Schenn hits the post. Shot chance came after Eklund between-the-legs move. #Isles
Emil Heineman waits too long on 2-on-1 with Eklund. Pass was taken away. #Isles
